title: Vendor Conflict Allegation: Uncorroborated Competitor Complaint vs. Corroborated Bank Wire to Former Manager
shared_context: Vendor #4491 (Apex Cloud Logistics) had a prior familial-conflict disclosure that expired 44 months ago (outside the 36-month policy lookback window). A competitor submits a hotline complaint alleging hidden control by a former procurement manager.

pivotal_evidence_item.summary: Independent state corporate registry extract and audited beneficial-ownership schedule confirming zero equity, debt, or fee transfers between Apex Cloud Logistics and any current or former procurement personnel.

Independent clearing bank wire record showing a $185,000 'consulting rebate' disbursed by Apex Cloud Logistics to an LLC whose sole registered member is the former procurement manager who approved Vendor #4491's contract renewal 8 months ago.

title: Sub-Processor Q4 Attestation Gap: Signed Officer Bridge Letter + CUEC Logs vs. Informal Account-Exec Email
shared_context: A Tier-1 payment settlement sub-processor's SOC 2 Type II report covers Jan 1 – Sep 30, leaving Oct 1 – Dec 31 (Q4) outside the CPA attestation window.

pivotal_evidence_item.summary: Formal SOC 2 Bridge Letter signed by the sub-processor's Chief Information Security Officer and General Counsel covering Oct 1 – Dec 31, paired with verified internal Complementary User Entity Control (CUEC) cryptographic logs showing zero exceptions.
Unsigned email from the vendor's regional account executive stating 'nothing changed in Q4, our controls remain solid' with no officer attestation and no CUEC verification.
